changes.history: Cold recent requests avoid unbounded attach history and prefer native bounded paging even when metadata lacks paging hint; watched nonpaged metadata cannot start concurrent full recovery. Older runtimes without paging retain explicit fallback.
changes.reopen: Four two-minute recent-page entries, keyed by hashed backend owner and exact thread. Restore before refreshing. Navigation never renews stale TTL; memory release clears cache. Late responses/deltas cannot cross ownership.
changes.state: Persistent authored working/thinking icon and Needs you/Your turn labels in existing conversation control bar. Pending questions override active runtime status; streamed activity visible before task list catches up.
changes.backend: Selector in Settings; reachable from both backends without permanent extra footer. Team Settings retains underlying conversation, and notification routing closes overlay.

limitations: Synthetic native latency checks are deliberately delayed fixtures, not an acoustic/provider test or a phone-network benchmark.
Older Codex runtimes without native paging still require the compatibility full-history read.
ownedResources: Original emulator preferences restored and hash verified. Owned26 emulator/fixture stopped; unrelated resources and shared ADB preserved.
